title: Gotrade Daily: Jobs Report Tests Stocks After Yield Spike
summary: The September jobs report lands tonight after the 10-year Treasury yield briefly hit its highest level since 2002. Watchlist: NVDA, AVGO, XOM, NKE.

## Tonight's Key Events


### The September jobs report


The[US Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/empsit.htm) releases nonfarm payrolls at 8:30 a.m. ET. According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/01/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html) , the Dow Jones consensus calls for 84,000 new jobs, with unemployment holding at 4.1%. Fed funds futures show a 72% likelihood that the Fed holds rates in October.


### Fed officials still lean hawkish


Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan estimates that at least two more 25-basis-point rate hikes are needed, according to[Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4649588-dallas-feds-logan-estimates-at-least-two-more-25-bp-rate-hikes-are-needed) . Fed Governor Lisa Cook sees the AI buildup as the top inflation risk for 2027, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/feds-cook-sees-ai-buildup-as-top-inflation-risk-for-2027-93CH-4928751) .
